open-vs-code.inferenceBackend.description: Explicit inference backend. HALO failures never fall back to standalone local inference.

open-vs-code.halo.timeoutMs.description: Maximum HALO request duration in milliseconds.

open-vs-code.skills.enabled.description: Enable the Portable Skills Runtime: select at most one task-specific SKILL.md (built-in or .open-vs-code/skills) and load it lazily. Skills are guidance only and never grant permissions. Off until the HALO A/B benchmark is recorded.

open-vs-code.workflow.enabled.description: Run eligible Build/Debug tasks through the Structured Engineering Loop (PLAN → IMPLEMENT → TEST → fresh-context REVIEW → VERIFY). Every change and check still needs your approval. Off until the HALO A/B benchmark is recorded.

open-vs-code.progressMonitor.enabled.description: Detect when a task stops making progress (the same failure, edit or tool call repeating), run one bounded diagnostic recovery, and otherwise stop as Blocked with the reason and a recommended next step. Never grants permissions. Off until the HALO A/B benchmark is recorded.

open-vs-code.learning.enabled.description: After each task, record compact evidence-backed lessons and propose project memory or project-local skills for your review (Open VS Code: Review Learning Candidates). Only what you approve is ever used in prompts; learning never grants permissions. Off until the HALO benchmark is recorded.

open-vs-code.account.serverUrl.description: URL of the Open VS Code Account Service.

open-vs-code.account.autoSyncIntegration.description: Automatically synchronize saved MCP integrations upon login.

open-vs-code.browser.allowedOrigins.description: Explicitly authorized exact browser origins and ports for this workspace (e.g. ["http://127.0.0.1:3000"]).

open-vs-code.browser.headless.description: Launch governed Chromium browser in headless mode.
